CITY OF EL MONTE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA FOR THE
  STANDING STREET VENDOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  October 10, 2022 - 9:00 a.m.
  Virtual Meeting via Zoom
  Join Zoom Meeting
  https://us06web.zoom.us/j/88482235025

This meeting shall be conducted in compliance with the procedures set forth under AB361 which
allows local legislative bodies to continue conducting virtual meetings under certain emergency
circumstances without strictly complying with traditional Brown Act teleconferencing requirements,
so long as there is a live comment option for public comments, meetings are paused for any technical
difficulties that affect public participation, and each agenda contains information on how to access
the meeting as well as how to participate in public comment virtually. The El Monte City Council has
availed itself of the procedures of AB361 for meetings of the City of El Monte’s Legislative Bodies by
resolution last approved at its meeting of October 4, 2022.

Members of the public wishing to observe the meeting and provide public comment may do
so in one of the following ways:

  1. Join Zoom Meeting https://us06web.zoom.us/j/88482235025
  Meeting ID: 884 8223 5025

  2. Dial +1 669 444 9171
  Meeting ID: 884 8223 5025

 1.  CALL TO ORDER

 2.  ROLL CALL

 3.  FLAG SALUTE

 4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask questions
  on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to two (2) minutes per person.
  A) Update on Code Enforcement efforts with LA County Public Health
  B) Impacts on public right-of-way, storm drains, school and park sites
  C) Overview of Senate Bill (SB) 972
